context: J.P. Morgan Personal Investing sets the eligibility, qualifying activity and reward conditions. Read the invitation and the provider’s terms before proceeding.
steps: Open the invitation and read the six-month promotional fee terms and eligible products.
Consider the product, risk and all charges before deciding whether to apply.
If you proceed, follow the provider’s sign-up and funding requirements, then check when the promotional fee period starts and ends.
tip: No management fees does not mean there are no costs. Check underlying fund costs and other charges, plus the standard management fee after the promotion.
eligibility: Qualifying new customers and eligible products; the invitation’s funding and timing conditions apply.
terms: The shared invitation offers six months without portfolio management fees on qualifying investments, subject to the provider’s terms.
Other charges, including underlying investment costs where applicable, may remain payable. Standard management fees apply after the promotional period.
Check eligible accounts, required funding and the start date of the fee-free period in the invitation. Tax treatment and product suitability depend on individual circumstances.
Capital at risk. A referral benefit is not a reason on its own to invest.
questions: Does six months with no management fees mean investing is completely free?
No. The promotion concerns portfolio management fees. Other investment costs or charges may still apply, and normal management fees resume after the promotional period.
Is my investment guaranteed?
No. Investment values can fall and you may get back less than you invest. Read the provider’s risk information before proceeding.
riskNote: Capital at risk. Investment values can fall and you may get back less than you invest. This referral is not a personal investment recommendation.

name: eToro
description: A personal account invitation with no promised visitor payout.

context: eToro sets the eligibility, qualifying activity and reward conditions. Read the invitation and the provider’s terms before proceeding.
steps: Open the invitation and read the terms applicable to your country and account.
Review product risks, charges and account requirements before deciding whether to apply.

tip: Choose whether a service is suitable based on its products, risks and costs, rather than a referrer’s reward.
